packageRules.description: Non-major updates merge themselves once CI is green: dev tooling, the toolchain (packageManager, mise, nvm, engines) and GitHub Actions.
Runtime dependencies of a published package ship to consumers, so a human decides.
astro check cannot run on TypeScript 7 yet (no programmatic API); hold the website on TS 6 until Astro supports it.
@types/node tracks the supported Node range, so bumps are a deliberate call.
